== Usage ==
Place this notification template immediately before the applicable [[Wikipedia:WikiProject Lists#Incomplete lists|incomplete list]] (i.e. in a section, not at the top of the article). This template will automatically add the article to [[:Category:Dynamic lists]].

== What is a dynamic list? ==
From [[Wikipedia:Manual of Style/Lists#Special names of lists]]:

{{blockquote|A dynamic list is any list that may never be fully complete (since it will only include [[WP:N|notable]] examples from a given category), or may require constant updates to remain current.}}

See [[Wikipedia:WikiProject Lists#Dynamic lists]]

== Parameters ==
<templatedata>
{
	"params": {
		"multiple": {
			"label": "Multiple lists?",
			"description": "Set to yes to change the wording for articles containing multiple dynamic lists.",
			"type": "boolean",
			"autovalue": "yes",
			"suggested": true
		}
	}
}
</templatedata>
